full_prompt_en: A square, sharply rendered rural painting looks across a calm lake toward gold fields and a small red barn. In the lower middle, a single person in a pale wide-brimmed hat sits in a deep red rowboat, facing away and holding a long oar that angles across the water to the right. The boat casts a dark red reflection beneath it. The lake fills almost the lower half, its dark blue base broken by many small white, silver, and peach ripples that mirror the bright sky. A dense row of sunflowers borders the near shore along the bottom edge, their dark centers and yellow petals forming a textured foreground band. Beyond the water, yellow crop fields roll in broad diagonal slopes from left to right, divided by narrow green edges. A compact two-story red barn stands slightly right of center, its dark roof and small windows clear against the gold. A cluster of full green trees rises to its left, and another line of trees recedes along the distant ridge. Above, an enormous assembly of white and cream cumulus clouds fills the blue sky. Their rounded forms have softly shadowed undersides but crisp sunlit ridges. The strong daylight appears to come from above and left, brightening the fields, cloud tops, and water flashes while leaving deep shadow in the trees and under the boat. The composition is built from horizontal bands of flowers, lake, fields, and sky, interrupted by the small red focal shapes. Tight detail in the foreground and broad luminous color areas in the distance create a cheerful, spacious summer atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、刻画清楚的乡村绘画越过平静湖面，望向金色田野和一座小红谷仓。下部中央，一位戴浅色宽檐帽的人背对观者坐在深红色划艇里，握着向右斜伸过水面的长桨。船下投出深红倒影。湖面占据接近下半幅，深蓝底色被许多小块白、银和桃色涟漪打断，映出明亮天空。密密一排向日葵沿下缘围住近岸，深色花心和黄花瓣形成有肌理的前景带。水对面，黄色作物田沿宽阔对角坡地从左向右起伏，之间隔着细绿边界。一座紧凑的两层红谷仓立在中央稍右，深色屋顶和小窗在金色田地前很清楚。其左侧升起一簇浓绿树木，另一排树沿远方山脊后退。上方，庞大的白色与奶油色积云群填满蓝天。圆鼓形云朵下侧柔软带阴影，日照边缘却清晰。强烈日光似从左上方来，照亮田地、云顶和水面闪光，让树内与船底保持深暗。构图由花丛、湖、田地和天空的水平色带构成，小块红色焦点穿插其中。前景紧密细节与远处宽阔发光色域共同形成明朗、宽敞的夏日氛围。
style_prompt_en: A clear, detailed painted surface uses saturated blue, golden yellow, and compact red accents in broad horizontal layers. The upper area carries rounded, sunlit pale volumes with softly shaded undersides; the middle uses smooth, sweeping fields of warm color interrupted by dark green clusters. In the lower zone, short broken blue, white, and peach marks make a sparkling reflection pattern. A dense fringe of repeated yellow and dark dots gives the foreground a close texture. Edges are mostly crisp, especially where small accents cross large color areas, while atmospheric forms retain softer modeling. Bright daylight lifts the yellows and whites and creates strong but localized shadow. The rhythm moves from fine foreground repetition through wide diagonal bands to generous rounded forms above, giving the composition a calm, expansive clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 清楚细致的绘画表面在宽阔水平层次中使用饱和蓝、金黄及紧凑红色重音。上部区域容纳受日光照亮的圆润浅色体量，下侧柔和带阴影；中部以平顺扫过的暖色田块为主，被深绿簇形间断。下部短促断裂的蓝、白和桃色笔痕形成闪烁倒影纹。重复黄点和深色小点密集排成前景边饰，使近处有细密质感。边缘大多清楚，尤其是小色块切过大片色域的地方；空气中的形体仍较柔和。明亮日光抬高黄与白，同时留下强烈但局部的阴影。节奏从前景细密重复，经宽阔斜向色带，进入上部宽裕的圆形体量，令构图平静、开阔且清晰。
theme_en: A red rowboat on a lake beside a golden field and red barn
theme_zh: 金色田野与红色谷仓旁湖面上的红色小船
name: John Sloane
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
